># Major Update:
>
>> Starting from version 2.0.1, this mod now uses` malilib` as its configuration dependency instead of `Yet Another Config Lib`.And aslo reqires `RyansRenderingKit`
>> The codebase has been almost completely refactored. Some old features, such as Trajectory and ProjectileCamera, have been removed, while several new features have been introduced. You can open the configuration by pressing X + V or via Mod Menu

# lucidity
![](https://count.getloli.com/@lucidity?name=lucidity&theme=3d-num&padding=7&offset=0&align=top&scale=1&pixelated=1&darkmode=auto)
> The Ultimate Client-Side Visualization Tool!
## What Is This
This mod adds various client-side visual features, such as 

- selective block/entiy/particle rendering
- fluid source highlighting
- orientation display
- ore highlighting
- container comparator output display
- ...more!
- 
- ~~mob tracking range visualization~~(v2.0 -)
- ~~previews for certain commands.~~(v2.0 -)
- ~~damage indicator~~(v2.0 -)
- ~~projectile trajectory prediction~~(v2.0 -)


## Main Features

### Selective Rendering

This feature offers various selective rendering options ("Specific Content" below refers to the selected blocks/entities/particles by the player).

Block/Entity/Particle Rendering Modes:

- Disabled

- Render specific content inside the selection area

- Render specific content outside the selection area

- Do not render specific content inside the selection area

- Do not render specific content outside the selection area

- Render only specific content

- Do not render specific content

- Render everything inside the selection area

- Render everything outside the selection area

- Render everything inside the selection area except specific content

- Render everything outside the selection area except specific content


### Ore Highlighting

Highlights ores within the detection range (allows adding custom blocks as ores and adjusting highlight colors per ore type).

### Key Display

Displays all pressed keys.

### Damage Indicator

Indicates the source of damage

Calculates potential damage


### Fluid Highlighting

Applies a special highlight texture to fluid blocks from texture packs.

- Fluid source direction 
- Bubble column direction

### Projectile Trajectory

Marks the following with lines:

- Predicted trajectory of projectiles held by other players

- First-person predicted trajectory of held projectiles

- Predicted trajectory of projectiles held by mobs/entities

- Real-time predicted trajectory of existing projectiles in the world


### Explosion Visualization

Explosion Visualization 
A powerful tool that simulates and visualizes explosion details in real time, including:

- Explosion rays

- Blocks that will be destroyed

- Explosion center

- Estimated damage to nearby entities

- Sample points of affected entities


### Mob Debug Renderings

- Visualizes areas where entities can detect target.
- Displays spawnable entities on blocks around the player(not alwaysaccurate).
- Displays a line between entity's eye and its target's eye.
- Shows the effective attack range of sonic booms.

### Creative Helper

- Displays the range of certain commands (/fill, /clone)

- Improves the visibility of structure voids

- Enhances the appearance of barriers

- Forces the rendering of some technical blocks (barriers, structure voids, etc.)


### Other Fun Features! 

- Press Ctrl while firing a projectile to switch your view to the projectile's perspective (press Shift to reset view)

- Visualizes surrounding sound events (e.g., footsteps)

- Displays surrounding block events (accuracy not guaranteed)

projects.description: Bakes redstone dust update order into 3D planes and voxel clouds drawn in the world.
projects.longDescription:
# VisualDust 

## Commands

All commands are **client‑side only**.  
The server does **not** need to install anything.

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `/visualdust here <x\|y\|z> [order\|group]` | Add a plane at the player’s current coordinates |
| `/visualdust add <x\|y\|z> <coord> [order\|group]` | Add a plane at a specified coordinate |
| `/visualdust remove <x\|y\|z> <coord>` | Remove a plane |
| `/visualdust clear` | Clear all planes |
| `/visualdust list` | List all current planes |
| `/visualdust mode <order\|group>` | Switch the color mode of all planes |
| `/visualdust alpha <0-100>` | Opacity (%) — default is 70 |
| `/visualdust radius <8-256>` | Baking radius (blocks) — default is 96 |
| `/visualdust query` | Print the update order and group classification of the block under your feet |
| `/visualdust search <d1> [d2..d6]` | Search by update‑order prefix and highlight matching cells on the plane |
| `/visualdust search <d1..> <sizeX> <sizeY> <sizeZ>` | Search inside a cuboid centered on the player; matching blocks appear as cube clouds |
| `/visualdust search` | With no parameters, clear search highlights |

`x` planes cover (Y, Z),  
`y` planes cover (X, Z),  
`z` planes cover (X, Y).  
Vertical range is clamped to world height.

Up to **16 planes** can exist at once.  
Planes on the same axis and same coordinate **replace** each other instead of stacking  
(stacking would cause repeated blending of transparency).

---

## Searching by Update Order

`/visualdust search` takes **1–6 directions**, matching the **prefix** of the block update order:

```
/visualdust search self down south      # Equivalent to O -Y +Z
/visualdust search                      # No parameters = clear highlights
```

Directions may be written as:

- `self` `down` `up` `north` `south` `west` `east`
- or equivalently  
  `O` `-Y` `+Y` `-Z` `+Z` `-X` `+X`

### Structure‑aware autocomplete

Autocomplete only shows directions that can extend the current prefix into a **real existing** update order.  
Impossible structural combinations simply never appear.

Example:

```
(empty)            -> 5 options: O  -Y  +Y  -Z  +Z      ← +X/-X proven never to lead
O                  -> 4 options: -Y  +Y  -Z  +Z
O -Y               -> 1 option: +Z
O -Y +Z            -> 1 option: +X
O -Y +Z +X         -> 1 option: +Y
O -Y +Z +X +Y      -> 2 options: -Z  -X
```

Repeated directions are naturally excluded — once a direction is used, no valid sequence can follow it, so autocomplete shows nothing.

### Why up to 6 directions?

There are 7 elements in the update order.  
The first 6 positions uniquely determine the 7th, so 6 parameters give an exact match.

Manually typing structurally impossible combinations (autocomplete won’t show them, but you can force them) will report **“does not exist”**, e.g.:

```
/visualdust search east   # +X leading — mathematically impossible
```

Matching cells are baked into a separate VertexBuffer and overlaid in bright yellow on top of the plane’s color mode.

---

## Cuboid Search

If you add three sizes after the directions, the mode switches from **plane highlight** to **cube cloud**:

```
/visualdust search O -Y +Z 64 64 64
```

Inside a `sizeX × sizeY × sizeZ` cuboid centered on the player, all matching blocks are rendered as cube clouds.

- Each axis max: **512**
- Max scan volume: **16.77 million blocks (256³)**
- **The center is fixed at the moment you run the command** — it does not follow the player afterward.

---

## Two Color Modes

### **order**
Color based on the full 7‑direction update order using Fourier coloring.  
All **5040 permutations** have unique colors.

### **group**
Color based on the 3‑group classification:

- 6 colors (red/orange/pink variants)  
  - Hue = which group leads  
  - Brightness = order of the remaining two groups
- Blocks not fitting the grouping are colored **gray**  
  (about **2.93%** of all blocks).
